name: mac-management-system
description: Armoury Crate-like performance orchestration for macOS

scripts.build:daemon: mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && make -j$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu)
scripts.build:ui: cd ui && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:daemon && npm run build:ui
scripts.clean: rm -rf build && cd ui && rm -rf node_modules dist
